parsed.name: 串口仪器通信基类组件
parsed.description: 非物理实验软件组件，用于实验自动化中通过 pyserial 管理串口连接、收发原始字节数据并检查端口状态，作为各类串口仪器驱动的通用基础类。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical laboratory software component used in automation to manage serial connections via pyserial, send and receive raw byte data, and check port status. It serves as a common base class for serial instrument drivers.

actions.description_en: Check whether the serial port is open.

actions.description: 通过串口发送原始字节数据。
actions.description_en: Send raw byte data through the serial port.

actions.description: 通过串口接收指定长度的原始字节数据。
actions.description_en: Receive raw byte data of a specified length through the serial port.
